results.evidence: The route's own listing gives 800 ft (242 m) overall but pitch lengths of 150/100/150/110/200/100/150 ft plus a variable finish, which sum to over 960 ft; the row copies both, so the conflict is in the source itself. No second independent account of the route's length or pitch lengths was found (FA report and other pages give only grade/name). Would settle with a second trip report or topo stating the total length or per-pitch lengths.

The North Face listing warns only that there are many places to get the rope stuck. A 2004 party account records a rope stuck on the first double-rope rappel and a 50 ft scramble to free it, and another party had ropes tangle on the last two rappels; neither mentions a constriction above a wide crack or a 5.8 lead, so no source places the incident on rappel 1 or 3. Would settle with the original account of the 5.8 re-lead naming the rappel.

USGS 1 m lidar point elevation at the stored summit pin reads 8,482 ft (matching the waypoint's 8,483), while the topo-derived list gives 8,492 ft (matching high_point_ft); a 9 ft gap on a spire top where a 1 m DEM may miss the highest block. The peak database page could not be fetched to break the tie. Would settle with the peakbagger lidar figure or a finer lidar sampling of the summit block.

results.fact: Rope needed for the North Face rappels
results.evidence: Sources agree on 5 double-rope rappels and that a single 60 m works with some downclimbing while a 70 m is nicer; one party on two 60s describes a doubled first rap, one single rap to the pitch-3 ledge and three more doubles; another reports a 9-10 rappel single-rope descent and another a 60 m plus tag line with full-length rappels. None gives per-station lengths, so the 40/55/55/40/60 m table and the 'a 70 m single reaches' claim cannot be confirmed or corrected. Would settle with a topo giving per-rappel lengths.

results.evidence: gain_ft 6,000 is below the net rise from the 1,500 ft landing, but the only car-to-car figure from the Lightning Creek landing (~8,500 ft over 39 mi walking) is from one 2023 party. The Freezeout Creek route page gives only a partial figure (+1,200/-800 ft to Turner Bridge) from a different start, and another report (4,700 ft) is from Manning Park. Would settle with a second independent trip from the Lightning Creek landing stating total gain.

The 2023 party walked 39 mi round trip from SR-20 via the Lightning Creek landing (~19 mi each way from the landing); the Freezeout Creek route page gives ~34 mi round trip but measured from the Hozomeen side (Willow Lake 5 mi, Turner Bridge 7.5 mi, cabin 11.3 mi), a different start; the Manning Park report (29 mi) is a different approach. No two sources agree on the one-way distance for this row's approach. Would settle with a second trip report or track from the Lightning Creek landing.
